title: Travel & Retreats for NGOs and Non-profits | ETHPL
meta: Retreats, field-team gatherings, donor visits and CSR trips for NGOs and non-profits, planned around tight budgets and reporting requirements.
heading: For NGOs, non-profits and CSR teams
intro: Non-profit travel runs on money that was raised for something else, and every rupee has to be justifiable to a funder. The planning problem is not luxury, it is getting a genuinely useful gathering out of a budget that cannot flex.
concerns: Costing that starts from your ceiling rather than working down to it, and a straight answer about what a lower number genuinely buys.
Itemised invoicing and the supporting documentation that grant reporting and audits require, structured so it does not have to be reconstructed later.
Field staff travelling in from different states on different budgets and timings. Coordinating that is usually the hardest part, and it is planned as its own workstream.
A working venue that supports long sessions and real conversation beats a resort with a better lobby. We will say so when it is the better use of the money.
formats: Corporate CSR trips and volunteering programmes
cta: Talk to us about a retreat or convening
